answer: Each identity must hold 3 pearl tokens, each proof of attending a gathering in 90 days; each caps entrants at 40, organizer locks 200 POA, slashed for fakes. A pearl is issued only when 2 witnesses countersign its 14-field sonnet record; the nebula registry lists every record on-chain. Forging 100 identities needs 300 slots in 8 gatherings, 4500 POA in bribes at 15 POA a slot, each further fake paying more as slots run dry. Verifiers replay the records; a gathering with 2 fake pearls loses its deposit and is struck from the nebula, while a wrongly flagged venue can appeal with witness proof.
